rationale: Production-grade Gold/CDP contract. correctness=5: PK + FK + enums + nullability + min constraints + reasonable types. completeness=5: owner + SLA + retention + cadence + consumes[] all set. security=4: customer_id is classification=pii + masking=hash_sha256 (canonical example); not 5 because shipping_country and channel could be considered quasi-identifiers for re-identification. governance=5: team + email + slack + classification + retention + lineage. performance=5: clustering on (customer_id, order_date), partitioning on order_date by month — textbook layout. documentation=5: description on every column; product-level description; per-field semantics explicit.
